_comment: Org-wide acos defaults, shipped with acos-aboutme. Every value here is the same for everyone in the organization, so it lives in one shipped file rather than being copied into each person's state/profile.json. Consuming skills load this first, then overlay the profile: any key the profile sets wins, anything it omits falls back here. That means a profile written before a default existed still gets it, which is the failure this file exists to prevent — functional_area_keyword_patterns moved into the profile schema in acos-aboutme 0.4 and every profile created before that silently lost Functional Area tagging, with no error.

jira_workspaces._comment: cloud_id is the one Jira Cloud site the whole organization shares. product_fields are Jira Product Discovery custom-field IDs, which are assigned per site, so they are correct for every project on that site and meaningless on another. upcoming_window_days is a starting default a person may override in their own profile.

calendar_analysis._comment: functional_area_keyword_patterns and functional_area_disambiguation are the shared Functional Area tagging vocabulary — generic subject/attendee matching rules, no personal content. Their keys are also the canonical area names a profile's own functional_areas people-directory should use. time_allocation_targets are the benchmark ranges per staff position type; a person overrides them via calendar_analysis.time_allocation_target_overrides in their own profile, not by editing these. working_hours is a starting default.

working_hours._comment: CONFIRMED 2026-08-10. Saturday/Sunday zero-width by deliberate choice, not the literal Step-1 default -- found via testing that leaving weekends on the 08:00-17:00 default silently counted ~18 idle weekend hours/week as 'available capacity' in the time-allocation denominator, inflating Free time % and deflating every other category's %.
